notes.title: The ONE PIECE ODYSSEY adventure continues with “Reunion of Memories”!
notes.content:
[h2]You might have to [b]return to Memoria[/b] to [b]unravel [i]one final hidden mystery[/i][/b].[/h2]

[previewyoutube=fEVtFvDa8eQ;full][/previewyoutube]
The [b]famous pirates[/b] are finally resting after their [b]unbelievable adventures on the island of Waford and in Memoria[/b], the [i]world made of their memories[/i]. But as they [b]celebrate their last night together before sailing away[/b], a [b]girl who looks like Lim[/b] appears dressed in black clothes with her hood pulled over her face, [i]holding a sinister black cube in hand[/i]... 

But [i]who is she[/i]? The [b]Straw Hat Crew will be forced back into Memoria[/b] and transported again to Alabasta, although it [i]seems different from last time[/i], and the [b]cube needed to escape has disappeared[/b]!

notes.title: Introducing a new in-depth overview: the journey to the Capital of Water!
notes.content:
[h2]Discover [b]new gameplay[/b], [b]enigmas to solve[/b], and explore the [b]City of Water[/b] while [b]riding a Yagara Bull[/b]![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42689771/ab90fbb8e8e72a57d36f26a0148dabaede685dca.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=pRasasxoLI4;full][/previewyoutube][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42689771/e3677ce1b5d6602d05a71e228c0fb4600537d04e.png[/img]

In [b]ONE PIECE ODYSSEY[/b], players will adventure in "[i]Memoria[/i]", the [b]world of memories of the Straw Hat Crew[/b], some of which happening in [b]Water Seven[/b], in which they will have to [i]explore the city[/i] as well as [b]the famous Gallery-La Company[/b]. They will also [i]face well known foes[/i] such as [b]CP9’s Lucci[/b] and [b]Kaku[/b], but what awaits the player is a [i]new drama experience[/i] unique to [b]ONE PIECE ODYSSEY[/b].

This new video also showcases [b]Bond Arts[/b], [i]powerful special attacks[/i] made by three characters that have to be unlocked by completing the [b]Memory Link Quest[/b], which allows players to [i]resolve frayed memories[/i] and experience the [b]bond between the Straw Hat Crew members[/b]. 

The trailer also explains part of the [b]training system[/b] that will allow players to [i]collect cubes in various locations[/i] and [i]use their power[/i] to [b]enhance your favorite skills[/b] and [b]gain the upper hand in battle[/b].

[h3]Dive deeper into the [b]world of memories[/b] in [b]Water Seven[/b]![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/814000/ONE_PIECE_ODYSSEY/

tags.feature: Discover new gameplay, enigmas to solve, and explore the City of Water while riding a Yagara Bull!

In ONE PIECE ODYSSEY, players will adventure in "Memoria", the world of memories of the Straw Hat Crew, some of which happening in Water Seven, in which they will have to explore the city as well as the famous Gallery-La Company.
They will also face well known foes such as CP9’s Lucci and Kaku, but what awaits the player is a new drama experience unique to ONE PIECE ODYSSEY.

This new video also showcases Bond Arts, powerful special attacks made by three characters that have to be unlocked by completing the Memory Link Quest, which allows players to resolve frayed memories and experience the bond between the Straw Hat Crew members.

The trailer also explains part of the training system that will allow players to collect cubes in various locations and use their power to enhance your favorite skills and gain the upper hand in battle.
Dive deeper into the world of memories in Water Seven!

notes.title: Discover more about ONE PIECE ODYSSEY gameplay!
notes.content:
[h2]Roam the streets of [b]Nanohana[/b] for [b]new quests[/b], and view more about the [b]battle system[/b] with [b]each member of the Straw Hat Pirates[/b]![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42689771/ab90fbb8e8e72a57d36f26a0148dabaede685dca.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=7FaR838OmQE;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42689771/e3677ce1b5d6602d05a71e228c0fb4600537d04e.png[/img]

In this [b]new gameplay trailer[/b], player can discover more about the [b]game features[/b] as well as seeing more of [b]Alabasta[/b], a familiar scenario [b]recreated from the Straw Hat Crew’s memories[/b] where they go in order to [b]gain back their lost powers[/b] and [b]learn more about the mysteries of Waford[/b]. 

[b]ONE PIECE ODYSSEY[/b] features [b]battles[/b], with [i]various attacks[/i], [i]skills[/i], and [i]items to be used[/i] to turn the tides in the [b]Straw Hat Crew’s favor[/b]. During these battles, players can use [b]different types of characters and skills[/b] to [i]exploit enemies weaknesses[/i], while using healing and items, such as [b]food prepared by Sanji[/b] to gain the upper hand. 

The [b]game’s epic battles[/b] feature a [b]unique mechanic[/b] where players overcome situations typical in [b]ONE PIECE[/b] called [b][i]Dramatic Scenes[/i][/b] that occur with [b]specific combat conditions that boost player progression[/b], letting the Straw Hat Crew earn increased experience for completing tasks. 

[h3]Make the [b]Cat Burglar proud[/b], grab some extra [i]jewellery[/i], [i]apples[/i], and [i]jellies[/i] by pre-ordering now! The pre-order bonuses also include the [b]Straw Hat Crew clothes at their early beginning in East Blue[/b]![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/814000/ONE_PIECE_ODYSSEY/

In this new gameplay trailer, player can discover more about the game features as well as seeing more of Alabasta, a familiar scenario recreated from the Straw Hat Crew’s memories where they go in order to gain back their lost powers and learn more about the mysteries of Waford.
ONE PIECE ODYSSEY features battles, with various attacks, skills, and items to be used to turn the tides in the Straw Hat Crew’s favor.
During these battles, players can use different types of characters and skills to exploit enemies weaknesses, while using healing and items, such as food prepared by Sanji to gain the upper hand.

The game’s epic battles feature a unique mechanic where players overcome situations typical in ONE PIECE called Dramatic Scenes that occur with specific combat conditions that boost player progression, letting the Straw Hat Crew earn increased experience for completing tasks.
Make the Cat Burglar proud, grab some extra jewellery, apples, and jellies by pre-ordering now! The pre-order bonuses also include the Straw Hat Crew clothes at their early beginning in East Blue!

notes.title: Expect the unexpected on your next adventure with the Straw Hats! ☠️
notes.content:
[h2]Pirates, prepare to set sail once again after this unfortunate shipwreck. It might just be the start of a bigger adventure...[/h2]

During their journey, the [b]Straw Hats[/b] headed by [b]Monkey D. Luffy[/b] are swallowed by a huge storm at sea and end up on a [i][b]mysterious island full of nature[/b][/i] amidst the storm, separated from each other, with the [b]Thousand Sunny[/b] completely broken.  

The crew set outs on a [b]new adventurous journey[/b] filled with wonders of a [i][b]raging nature[/b][/i], [i][b]powerful enemies[/b][/i], and [i][b]strange encounters with the island locals[/b][/i]. Players will have to work together with [b]Luffy and the members of his crew[/b] to set sail once again! 

[previewyoutube=SJ8oKWn_1Vs;full][/previewyoutube]
In the game, players can freely choose to [b]take on the role of any of the nine fan-favorite pirates[/b] - [i]Monkey D. Luffy[/i], [i]Roronoa Zoro[/i], [i]Nami[/i], [i]Franky[/i], [i]Sanji[/i], [i]Usopp[/i], [i]Nico Robin[/i], [i]TonyTony Chopper[/i], and [i]Brook[/i].

The [b]energetic Adio[/b] and the [b]taciturn Lim[/b], two new characters, and the [b]monsters[/b] that inhabit the game world were designed with the cooperation of [b]Eiichiro Oda, the author of ONE PIECE[/b].

[h3][b]The Crew is ready. Are you?[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/814000/ONE_PIECE_ODYSSEY/
